title: wss: no error behavior defined for structurally invalid ChatStreamEnable
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 §4.1 says ChatStreamEnable.dataTypes MUST be non-empty. If a client sends ChatStreamEnable with an empty dataTypes array, the spec defines no server behavior. The §7 unknown-type ignore rule applies to unknown @type values, not to structurally invalid messages of a known type. Decision: define what the server does — silently treat as no-op, treat as ChatStreamDisable, or send an error frame.
close_reason: Added error behavior: empty dataTypes or all-unrecognized dataTypes returns RequestError (invalidArguments) and leaves subscription state unchanged. Unrecognized values mixed with recognized ones are silently ignored, preserving forward compatibility.
